BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   D. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   C. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

5. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   C. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   C. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.

9. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Social Responsibility of Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A — Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Nairobi

4. C — Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Plan income and spending wisely

11. A — Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social Responsibility of Business; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Entrepreneurship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
